T: Eat me. Drink me. Happy unbirthday.
D: A curious girl follows a white rabbit down a hole into a very strange world.
P: Serve dessert when the Mad Hatter's unbirthday party gets going.
S: the little cake marked eat me
Small vanilla cakes baked in a mini muffin tin at 175C for 12 minutes, iced white with eat me piped on top in pink.
the oysters in Tweedledum and Tweedledee's story

Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with a sharp mignonette of eschalot, red wine vinegar and cracked pepper, and lemon wedges. Finely dice 1 eschalot and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar, 1 tsp caster sugar and plenty of cracked black pepper, then chill for 30 minutes. Fill a large platter with crushed ice. Shuck 24 oysters, or buy them freshly shucked, and sit them on the ice. Spoon a little mignonette onto each just before eating and serve with lemon wedges.
the Queen of Hearts and her painted red roses
Puff pastry hearts baked at 200C for 12 minutes, split and filled with strawberry jam and whipped cream.
M: Mad Hatter's tea party finger sandwiches
the Mad Hatter's long tea table

Three kinds of crustless finger sandwiches, cucumber and cream cheese, egg and cress, and ham and mustard, stacked high on tiered plates. Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with 3 tbsp mayo and salt. Mix 150g cream cheese with chopped dill. Spread 12 slices of soft white bread with butter. Make 2 rounds of thin cucumber and cream cheese, 2 of egg and cress, and 2 of ham and mustard, using 150g ham. Trim the crusts and cut each round into 3 fingers. Stack on tiered plates.
Croquet lawn chicken and leek pie
the Queen's croquet game played with flamingos

Chicken and leek pie with a creamy thyme filling under a puff pastry lid, baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Brown 800g diced chicken thighs, then soften 2 sliced leeks. Stir in a spoon of flour, 250ml chicken stock, 200ml cream and thyme and simmer until thick. Pour into a dish, top with puff pastry and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.
W: Vanilla sponge baked in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes, sandwiched with jam and cream, iced in pastel colours with candles for nobody's birthday.
K: Drink me iced earl grey lemonade
the little bottle marked drink me

Earl grey tea brewed and cooled, mixed with lemonade and a little honey, served in teacups over ice. Brew 4 earl grey tea bags in 500ml boiling water and stir in a spoon of honey. Cool, then mix with 500ml lemonade and a squeeze of lemon. Pour over ice in mismatched teacups. Drink me, but not too much at once.

s.note: the little cake marked eat me
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 125g self-raising flour. Spoon into a mini muffin tin and bake at 175C for 12 minutes. Cool, ice white and pipe eat me on top in pink icing. Watch out for growing spurts.

s.note: the Queen of Hearts and her painted red roses
s.how: Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into hearts and bake at 200C for 12 minutes until puffed. Cool, split in half and fill with strawberry jam and whipped cream. Dust the tops with icing sugar. Keep a close eye on them, someone always steals the tarts.

w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Sandwich with strawberry jam, ice in pastel colours with icing sugar and add candles. Happy unbirthday to everyone.
